text:
Aisha K: Heads up — noticed ~2.3k contacts missing preference flags after last playbook run. Onboard healthscore and email_pref are out of sync for a batch of enterprise trials. Anyone else seeing this?
Ben R: Yup, saw the spike in the telemetry dashboard yesterday. Looks like the safelist filter excluded contacts where source=import_tool. Maybe the rule was tightened in the last PR.
Aisha K: Exactly — PR #342 adjusted the safelist regex. Not sure we backfilled the flags after the prune.
Sophie L: Can we run a backfill? Prefern't to reimport. What's the minimal SQL to target affected rows?
Lucas M: Quick snippet to test in sandbox:
```
UPDATE contacts
SET email_pref = COALESCE(metadata->>'email_pref','unknown')
WHERE source = 'import_tool' AND email_pref IS NULL
LIMIT 10000;
```
Sophie L: Thanks — I'll run that in sandbox and report. Any objections to a production dry-run first?
Ben R: No objections. Add a LIMIT/sample and check healthscore drift. Also verify playbook condition: `safelist = false` is the exclusion flag.
playbook-bot: playbook "contact-prune-v2" executed 2025-11-02 14:22 UTC — removed 5,432 candidates (dry-run=false).
Aisha K: That lines up. The prune removed rows but didn't trigger a reconcile step to set prefs. We need a reconcile task in the playbook.
Lucas M: Proposal: after prune step, run a backfill task that copies preference keys from `metadata.last_known_event` into `email_pref` and `healthscore_source`. I can open a PR for the playbook.
Sophie L: Also add telemetry: emit `cs.playbook.prune.removed` and `cs.playbook.reconcile.backfilled` with counts and a duration metric.
Ben R: +1. Recommend a canary rollout: 5% -> 30% -> 100% over 24h with automatic rollback on error rate > 0.5%.
Aisha K: Plan: Lucas PR by EOD, Sophie runs sandbox backfill and posts results, Ben drafts rollout steps, I'll own the postmortem and CS-facing note. Tagging @ops-bot to schedule the sandbox job.
ops-bot: scheduled job 'sandbox-contact-backfill' queued for 2025-11-03 09:00 UTC.
Sophie L: Ran sandbox job — backfill sample: 2,000 rows updated, no errors, median healthscore moved +0.03 for affected accounts. Logs look clean (truncated).
Lucas M: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/456 (adds reconcile task + metrics).
Aisha K: Great work team. After canary completes, we'll coordinate a CS owner email to impacted customers. I'll add a short runbook and lessons learned in the CS ops repo. Thanks all :raised_hands:
thread_summary: contact prune removed records without backfilling preference flags; plan to add reconcile task to playbook, run sandbox backfill, add telemetry and canary rollout
